It Girl

New York City, NY / 202417 photographs
About the project

Shot in Chelsea and Hell’s Kitchen, It Girl is a personal editorial in New York City with Roxy Pryor, one of my favorite collaborators. We’ve made four or five projects together, more than with any other model, and her consistency, talent, and presence always lift the final work.

The shoot focused on stylized fashion, bold texture, and close attention to detail. These are some of my favorite images to date: raw, clean, and full of energy. Sometimes the collaboration just clicks, and this was one of those days.
